content: “Asem-dd, ad dd-nedweř ɣar SIDI, maɣar Netta iqezzar, maca ad aneɣ issgenfa, Netta iwta, maca ad aneɣ icfen.
Awarni tnayen n wussan ad aneɣ yarr ɣar tudart, deg wass wiss třata ad aneɣ issnekkar u neccin ad neddar zzat i wudem nnes.
Xenni ad nessen, ad neḍfar maḥend ad nessen SIDI. Aḍhar nnes imten am tuffut n řefjar. Ad ɣarneɣ dd-yas am wenẓar, am wenẓar n arbiɛ nni issarḍaben tammurt.”
“Min akidek ɣa ggeɣ, a Ifrayim, min akidek ɣa ggeɣ, a Yahuda. Tamexsiwt nwem icewwaren tᵉttegg am useynu ɣar teffut u am nnda igeɛɛden uca xenni iqeṭṭa.
X uya Necc qesseɣ ten s tmijja n inabiyyen am s ijj n uyeřzim. Necc nɣiɣ ten s wawařen n uqemmum inu. Řeḥkamat xak amecnaw tfawt innufsřen.
Minzi ttexseɣ tamexsiwt icewwaren, war iǧi taɣarṣt, u tussna n SIDI ttexseɣ tt x tɣarṣa n wecmaḍ.”
“Nitni ɛeddan x Řɛahd am Adam. Dinni i d ayi ɣdaren.
Jilɛad d ict n tendint n yinni itteggen řmuɛṣiyyet, teccur s idammen.
Am yijj n bandiyya n ixewwanen i ittrajan ca n yijjen, ammu i teǧa terfiqt n ikehhanen. Nitni neqqen deg webrid i dd ittawyen ɣar Cakim, maɣar nitni tteggen řefḍayeḥ waha.
Necc ttwařiɣ tamesřact tessnexřaɛ di taddart n Israil, xzar, farq-ccɣeř n Ifrayim, Israil tessexmej ixef nnes.”
“Waxxa amenni, a Yahuda, aqa temmars ict n ṣṣabet i cek, xmi dd ɣa ssɛeqbeɣ imeḥbas n řgens inu.”
